git-r3-1.summary: log.showSignature adds signature banners to machine-parsed log stdout, rejecting history output and corrupting commitInfo.sha.
git-r3-1.fix: Add --no-show-signature to GitCommand.log and GitCommand.commitInfo while retaining %G? and exact message bytes. Update argv expectations in GitCommand.test.ts, Git.test.ts and GitLog.test.ts; add real-Git regressions for both service methods under repository-local log.showSignature=true in integration/GitSurface.int.test.ts and restore fixture config. Central deviation recording only; do not edit ledger or README Port notes.

git-r3-2.summary: A successful commitInfo invocation with empty stdout defects at S.asserts instead of returning a typed GitCommandError.
git-r3-2.fix: Make parseCommitInfo return a non-throwing parse result; require both NUL separators and valid signature-status data, preserving successful message bytes. Map parse misses to GitCommandError kind failed in the success handler using invocation metadata. Add empty/tree-ref output tests in Git.test.ts and a real tree-ref or empty-range regression in integration/GitSurface.int.test.ts. Keep schema-derived validation and do not restore the unsafe cast removed by step 2. Central deviation recording only.

git-r3-3.summary: SshFromEnv is a named, reused SSH configuration payload defined by a handwritten interface rather than a schema.
git-r3-3.fix: Replace SshFromEnv with a module-local identity-annotated schema with S.Option(S.String) fields and a schema-derived type. Preserve Option representation, blank-value policy, construction semantics, precedence and transport behavior without new restrictions or exports; retain Git.test.ts SSH regressions.

git-r3-4.summary: Insertion after an EOF backslash or final continuation consumes the new key or section into the preceding value.
git-r3-4.fix: Terminate open logical values with the additional line ending needed before new content, consistently in appendAtEof, append and insertEntry. Preserve ordinary formatting and existing values. Add append/set/addSection regressions in GitConfig.test.ts for bare EOF backslash, final LF continuation and final CRLF continuation, checking old value preservation and new entry/section existence. Coordinate scanner fixes in this group. Central deviation recording only.

git-r3-5.summary: Whitespace before continuations or an accepted EOF backslash is lost from decoded values and excluded from replacement spans.
git-r3-5.fix: Commit pending decoded whitespace and extend the significant raw span through continuations and the permitted unquoted EOF backslash. Preserve trimming of ordinary trailing whitespace. Add LF/CRLF/tab/comment/EOF/set fidelity regressions in GitConfig.test.ts and internal/config.coverage.test.ts; correct the EOF-whitespace expectation at GitConfig.test.ts:225 while preserving invalid quoted and terminal-CR escape cases. Central deviation recording only.

git-r3-6.summary: Empty quotes or initial continuations cause leading unquoted whitespace to be returned contrary to Git semantics.
git-r3-6.fix: Skip unquoted whitespace while decoded is empty, including after empty quotes and initial continuations; retain quoted/escaped whitespace and accurate source spans. Add GitConfig.test.ts and internal/config.coverage.test.ts regressions with the quoted-space control. Implement alongside git-r3-5 to keep continuation significance consistent. Central deviation recording only.
